card.name: Linking words after test or imaging names
card.fires_on: The small linking word or punctuation right after a named diagnostic test or imaging method, such as echocardiogram, PPD or MUGA. It sits where a second test or a method is about to be named.

modes.label: Or/comma after echocardiogram
modes.description: An 'or', comma or opening parenthesis follows echocardiogram or a similar cardiac test, before an alternative such as MUGA.

modes.label: After a lab test or measured substance
modes.description: A linking word follows a lab test name or the substance being measured, before the method or the next test.
modes.example: Use of mesalamine may lead to spuriously elevated test results when measuring urinary normetanephrine<< by>> liquid chromatography with electrochemical detection.
